**Finding submitted: deviation (LD), Section 7.7 (p0032).**

- **Issue:** Section 7.7 requires Customer to pay, "as liquidated damages and not as a penalty," 15% of annual Fees for *each week* an invoice remains unpaid — a Customer-payable liquidated sum triggered by a minor breach that compounds without cap, exceeding remaining contract value. This is walk-away territory and fails both the preferred and fallback positions.
- **Other locations checked:** Section 3 (no SLA/service-credit mechanics), Section 9.4 (termination without cause — Customer owes only accrued Fees, no minimum or early-termination fee), Section 21 (mutual cap; no LD), Section 27 (termination "without penalty"). No double-flagging with T4C, and no Vendor-to-Customer credits were flagged.
- **Cure (preferred, single operation):** Replace Section 7.7 with "Customer shall pay no liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement or any Order Form," which removes the formula entirely, leaves Section 7.3's dispute/no-interest mechanics untouched, and leaves no dangling cross-reference (no other clause cites 7.7).
